title: Hot Tub • Karaoke Loft •  3BR/2.5BA • Free Parking
description:
Welcome to Parton Me BnB, where Nashville style meets comfort. This 3BR/2.5BA home offers a private hot tub, karaoke loft with pool table, and a striking Dolly & Johnny mural. Designed for groups, it has 7 beds, spacious living, two 75” TVs, and a backyard with firepit, grill, and games. Just 4 miles from Broadway and under a mile from local breweries and dining, it’s an ideal home base for wedding groups, family getaways, friend reunions, and music lovers.

The space
Parton Me BnB is in the heart of The Nations neighborhood in West Nashville. Enjoy this little taste of Nashville while being minutes from the major attractions of the city.

HIGHLIGHTS
-Private Hot tub in fenced backyard 
-All beds are plush and comfortable for an easy night's sleep
-Breathtaking mural of LEGENDARY country music pioneers, Dolly Parton & Johnny Cash
-Karaoke set with endless music options on 75" TV & Vizio Soundbar
-Private outdoor deck with grill & furniture
-Fenced in yard with firepit & games

Floor 1:
Living Room, Kitchen, Half Bath, Washer+ Dryer Primary Bedroom & Bathroom
Floor 2:
Loft, Balcony, 2 bedrooms & bathroom
Outside the Back Door:
Back Deck, Fenced in Backyard

Guest access
Guest will have private access to the whole house. There is keyless lock with custom code for seamless entry.

Other things to note
